title: Home Made Kazoku Hip Hop Group to Return After 10-Year Hiatus
content: Japanese hip-hop group Home Made Kazoku announced on their official website on Tuesday that the group will return to making music. The announcement noted that the group remains under their old label Ki/oon Music , under Sony Music Labels . The group went on a hiatus after "The Last Live" concert on December 29, 2016.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai' Ends in Three Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for Shinya Misu 's Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai ( You Can't Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends! ) Manga announced on Tuesday that the series will end in three chapters.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Adds 7 Cast Members
content: The official website for Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, announced seven more cast members for the film on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Kuroema Series' Trailer Reveals LAUSBUB Theme Song
content: The staff of the live-action mini-series of Tsunami Umino 's Kuroema : Chole et Emma manga unveiled a new trailer and visual on Wednesday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "sign," which the band LAUSBUB created for the series.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Japan's Net Profit Drops 63% to 453 Million Yen (Updated)
content: The May 19 issue of the Japanese government's Kanpo gazette reported that the Japanese branch of Crunchyroll 's net profits for the fiscal period ending in December 2025 were 453 million yen (about US$2.85 million), a drop of 63% from the previously reported 1.239 billion yen (about US$7.79 million) in 2024.
author: ANN

title: Keiko Suenobu's Ochitara Owari Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: The Chukyo TV channel announced a live-action television series adaptation of Keiko Suenobu 's Ochitara Owari manga on Wednesday. The series will premiere in the "Suiyō Platinight" (Wednesday Platinum Night) timeslot on Chukyo TV , NTV , and their affiliated channels nationwide on July 1.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Cancels Yet Another Series in Just One Year
content: Thanks to the success of several long-running classics such as Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , etc., Weekly Shonen Jump became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Launched in 1968, the magazine has serialized countless incredible manga series and one-shots over the decades.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Best Action-Packed Anime of Winter 2026, Ranked
content: Winter 2026 was a fulfilling season for anime , with various types of series being released. From thrilling dramas to slice-of-life anime, dozens of titles managed to leave an impact. However, there is no denying that the genre that stood out the most last season was action anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book Switch 2 Game Streams Opening Cinematic
content: Nintendo began streaming on Tuesday the opening cinematic for the Yoshi and the Mysterious Book game, featuring Bowser Jr. In the game, Yoshi jumps into a magical book. While inside the book, Yoshi and the world adopt an artstyle that resembles a hand-drawn picture book.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll's Net Profit Falls By Over 60%: What This Might Mean for Anime Fans
content: Crunchyroll’s net profit for the fiscal year ending 2025 was 453 million yen (~$2.9 million), as published in Japan’s Official Gazette (and reported by media outlet Gamebiz). This marks a 63.4% decrease compared to the 1.239 billion yen Crunchyroll posted in FY2024.
author: Anime Corner
